scope: Reconcile existing IR15183 for POB04042 into local receipt history; no NetSuite transaction writes and no application deployment.
setup: Use existing Node and dependencies, isolated bounded Docker tests, existing repository finalizer; no new dependencies, git commits, or migrations.
acceptance: The posted receipt must match command external ID, PO ID, IR ID, all five selected line quantities, items, units and locations.
The sole additional line must be source PO line 22, item 3025, Other Charge / Purchase, quantity 1, freight amount 130.42, at location 1, without inventory accruals.
Reject altered identity, missing or additional inventory, mismatched freight, ambiguous line identity, or unreceived lines.
Reconcile through the existing posting repository and receiving finalizer; preserve the immutable request, photos and original uncertain attempt.
Resume, claim, recovered attempt, receipt history, order reference and audit must commit atomically; failed or dry runs leave business state unchanged.
Repeated or simultaneous recovery produces one receipt record and no new NetSuite transaction.
After repair the public job response and receipt history show IR15183; test resources are removed and production health remains good.

failureModel.wrongReceiptOrInventory: Exact source, request, receipt and line verification; hostile input tests and mutations.
failureModel.unconfirmedCharge: Incident-specific source-backed freight validation, including type, quantity, rate, amount and location.
failureModel.duplicateReceipt: No transform capability; existing command lock plus idempotent receipt finalization; repeat/concurrent isolated tests.
failureModel.partialLocalCommit: One outer database transaction; isolated rollback and injected failure tests.
failureModel.lostEvidence: Preserve original request and failed attempt; record recovery proof in saved response and audit.
failureModel.recurrence: General automatic handling of unselected PO freight remains outside this incident repair.
